name: NetScore Connector
author: netscoretechnologies2011

sections.description:
Integration for WooCommerce and Flexicon connects your WooCommerce store with Flexicon and NetSuite.
It enables real-time synchronization of products, inventory, and licenses with external ERP APIs.

Features

  • Sync WooCommerce products with Flexicon.
  • Manage stock across multiple locations.
  • Validate and activate licenses via external API.
  • Supports domain binding and license expiry.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/integration-for-woocommerce-and-flexicon/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings → Flexicon Integration to configure your API credentials.
  4. Save changes and start syncing.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Flexicon or NetSuite account?

Yes. You must have valid API credentials.

Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No, WooCommerce must be installed and active.
